calculation.description: For each tradable cross-asset instrument, subtract the equal-weight daily universe return from its daily return, sum the residual returns over 120 observations, lag all inputs by one completed observation, and invert the volatility-normalized trend. Positive values favor assets with weaker residual medium-term trends, implementing a robust cross-asset mean-reversion signal.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2,121 historical dates in the 15-asset synthetic cross-asset universe. Positive IC persisted in 2025-2032 regimes but weakened and turned slightly negative in 2033-2034, so recent drift should be monitored. No future data are used; signal is shifted one observation.
